Shipping/ is the F# library Contoso.Shipping. Version 1.0.0 is released. No package feed on this machine holds it, so release-1.0.0/ holds its released source. LegacyApp/ is an app that customers compiled against Shipping 1.0.0. They will replace Shipping.dll with version 1.1.0 and will not rebuild LegacyApp, so LegacyApp must keep working and print the same output with 1.1.0.

Make version 1.1.0 of Shipping with these features:

1. Express service: callers can ask for an express price. An express price is twice the standard price. The standard price does not change.
2. Insurance: callers can give a declared value for a parcel. The insured price is the standard price plus 1% of the declared value, rounded to 2 decimals.
3. Customs hold: a new parcel status Held, for a parcel that customs holds. In the parcel lifecycle it comes after InTransit and before Delivered. statusOf "HD" returns it.

Set the Shipping version to 1.1.0. Do not change LegacyApp/ or release-1.0.0/.

Write NewApp/Program.fs. NewApp is compiled against Shipping 1.1.0. It must use the Shipping library to print exactly these lines:

P1 standard 6.90
P1 express 13.80
P4 insured 13.50
HD Held

Parcel P1 weighs 2.0 kg. Parcel P4 weighs 5.0 kg and has a declared value of 300.00.
